headline: Sharp Dispute Over Prof. Glapiński; Opposition Raises Alarm
summary: The Civic Coalition and some coalition partners pushed through a committee report on a motion to refer National Bank of Poland President Adam Glapiński to the State Tribunal, drawing opposition alarm.
why: The National Bank of Poland sets interest rates and manages the zloty, so the independence and leadership of the central bank matter to Polish markets.
